lines.trans: I thought I would need to study.
I am tracing the history of our country's comedy, you could say.
Please introduce a little bit of what you learned.
First, I am comparing and analyzing fool characters.
There are many differences.
'Hello there,' while one throws a greeting like this,
the other opens the mouth small and vocalizes with a lisping sound,
Ah, but he uses a head voice.
'Not here,' like this, 'not here.'
Continuously throwing questions,
neutralizing that system,
if he pursues comedy.
